description: A provider adapter detects, from raw wire evidence, a second terminal signal for a call that already ended, and reports this explicitly as a provider_diagnostic (this detection happens in the adapter against raw provider events, not at this normalized layer - a bare duplicate tool_call_end with no such diagnostic is otherwise idempotent and does not by itself change an already-complete call's outcome). Once reported, the coordinator/gate must fail the call closed.

provenance.note: Models E_DUPLICATE_TOOL_END, emitted by every current provider adapter (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, the AI SDK adapter) when raw evidence shows a genuine second terminal event for the same call.

events.message: A second terminal event arrived for a call that already ended.
